claim: With on-demand pricing, DynamoDB lets you pay only for the resources you consume and scales to zero when not in use; while the database is in use, write request units and read request units are used to calculate charges.

evidence.quote: DynamoDB is unique as it's a serverless database that provides customers with the option of only paying for the resources they consume—while scaling to zero when not in use with on-demand pricing.
When the database is in-use, write request units and read request units are used to calculate charges.
